decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing the Blink mechanic to repeatedly flicker powerful creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk for value and aggression, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck aims to establish board control and tempo advantage through efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude. With a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents quickly while generating incremental advantage through blinking synergies.

This deck focuses on generating a high storm count to cast a lethal Grapeshot or Flame of Anor spell, utilizing cards like Manamorphose, Desperate Ritual, and Pyretic Ritual to ramp up mana quickly. The deck also includes cards like Stock Up and Past in Flames to recycle key spells from the graveyard. Ral, Monsoon Mage and Stormcatch Mentor provide additional support and card advantage, while the land base includes fetch lands and shock lands for consistency and mana fixing. The strategy revolves around chaining spells together to efficiently combo off and win the game in explosive fashion.

The deck focuses on using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand from the graveyard. By combining instant reanimation with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, the deck aims to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence. The inclusion of Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional removal and disruption options, while cards like Ephemerate and Quantum Riddler help to generate card advantage and maintain tempo.

The deck focuses on being able to quickly reanimate powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand, using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude. It also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo pieces. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to reduce the cost of the reanimation spells, while cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending allow for card advantage and filtering. Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional control and disruption, while Prismatic Ending deals with problematic permanents. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can combo off to generate infinite mana with Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies, allowing for a win condition with Walking Ballista. It includes tutor cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Summoner's Pact to search for key combo pieces. Leyline of Abundance and Nature's Rhythm provide mana acceleration and Boseiju, Who Endures can protect important spells from countermagic. The deck has a mix of aggressive creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and utility creatures like Duskwatch Recruiter to provide flexibility in different game situations.

This deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces such as Lotus Bloom and Goblin Charbelcher to quickly assemble a win condition without relying on traditional land drops. The deck includes a mix of disruption (Counterspell, Disrupting Shoal) and card filtering (Preordain, Whir of Invention) to protect the combo and find key pieces. Tameshi, Reality Architect and Hydroelectric Specimen offer alternative win conditions if the primary combo is disrupted. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its fast and unpredictable gameplay, requiring strategic decision-making and careful resource management.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with cheap artifacts and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Ornithopter, Memnite, and Cranial Plating to put pressure on the opponent early on. Tormod's Crypt and Urza's Saga provide additional utility and resource generation, while cards like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble help ramp up mana and card advantage. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Basim Ibn Ishaq offer card draw and control elements to maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to swarm the board with creatures and artifacts to outpace the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly generate mana using ritual spells and Ruby Medallion to cast powerful spells such as Ral, Monsoon Mage and Grapeshot. The deck also includes card draw and filtering through spells like Reckless Impulse and Wrenn's Resolve. The combo potential is enhanced by cards like Past in Flames and Wish, which can enable explosive turns. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's strategy, with lands like Gemstone Caverns and Valakut Awakening providing additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a burst of spellcasting.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to aggressively play low-cost threats like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's board with spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Preordain for card advantage and consistency, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the game tempo. The deck also includes some versatility with cards like Boomerang Basics and Experimental Synthesizer, allowing for adaptation to different game situations. Overall, the strategy focuses on fast, consistent damage output with efficient spell usage.

This combo deck utilizes Broodscale Bloodchief to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. The key strategy is to use cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to find the pieces needed for the combo, while controlling the board with removal spells like Dismember. By generating mana quickly and efficiently, the deck can overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and disrupt their game plan with cards like Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to win through a combination of aggressive creature plays and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces to create a powerful loop of sacrificing creatures and generating mana with Eldrazi Temple to cast Emrakul, the Promised End. The key idea is to use cards like Basking Broodscale and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate massive amounts of tokens and then sacrifice them to trigger effects like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command. The deck also utilizes artifacts like Urza's Saga and Springleaf Drum to ramp up quickly and overwhelm opponents with a swarm of Eldrazi creatures.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of cheap and efficient spells, along with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Monastery Swiftspear. By utilizing cards like Mutagenic Growth and Assault Strobe, the deck aims to deal fast and impactful damage to the opponent, while also maintaining card advantage through spells like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base is designed to provide consistency and flexibility, allowing the deck to consistently apply pressure and close out games quickly.

The main concept of this Modern combo deck is to fill the graveyard with creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Generous Ent, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield. Overlord of the Balemurk and Endurance are key creatures to have in the graveyard for this strategy. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Negation and disruption cards like Subtlety to protect the combo. Additionally, the deck has some flying threats like Colossal Skyturtle and Curator of Mysteries to pressure the opponent.

The key concept of this Boros Ponza control deck is to disrupt your opponent's mana base with land destruction spells like Cleansing Wildfire and Field of Ruin, while maintaining board control with removal spells such as Path to Exile and Wrath of the Skies. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through cards like Price of Freedom and Erode, while using Galvanic Discharge and Solitude to deal with threats efficiently. By slowing down the opponent's development and stabilizing the board, this deck can take control of the game and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing flicker effects and aggression to control the board and overwhelm the opponent. By repeatedly blinking powerful creatures like Quantum Riddler and Solitude, you can disrupt your opponent's game plan and apply pressure. The combination of Ephemerate and Flickerwisp allows for efficient flickering of creatures, while cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help maintain tempo and deal with threats. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can protect your creatures, disrupt your opponent's strategy, and generate additional value from cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending, as well as disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Teferi, Time Raveler. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with efficient creatures and disruptive plays.
